problem:
$$
f(x)∼\frac{{a}_{0}}{2}+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{n}\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{6}x)+{b}_{n}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{6}x)
$$

Let $F(x)=2{x}^{2}+7x+5$ for $x\in [-6,6).$ The Fourier series of the $12$-periodic extension $f(x)$ of $F(x)$ is shown above. Find the exact value of ${a}_{0}.$

${a}_{0}=$ {{field-1}}
worked_solution:
For the Fourier series of a $2L$-periodic function, the constant term is given by

$$
{a}_{0}=\frac{1}{L}{\int }_{-L}^{L}f(x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

In our case, $L=6$ and $f(x)=2{x}^{2}+7x+5$ for $x\in [-6,6).$ So, substituting into the formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{0} & =\frac{1}{6}{\int }_{-6}^{6}(2{x}^{2}+7x+5)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{6}{[\frac{2}{3}{x}^{3}+\frac{7}{2}{x}^{2}+5x]}_{-6}^{6} \\  & =\frac{1}{6}((\frac{2}{3}\cdot {6}^{3}+\frac{7}{2}\cdot {6}^{2}+5\cdot 6)-(\frac{2}{3}\cdot (-6)^{3}+\frac{7}{2}\cdot (-6)^{2}+5\cdot (-6))) \\  & =\frac{1}{6}(300-(-48)) \\  & =58.\end{aligned}
$$
